spec.name: A
spec.query: ((kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace="<NAMESPACE>",deployment=~"bkout-one-workflow-backend|workflow-queue-workers"} < on(namespace,deployment) kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace="<NAMESPACE>",deployment=~"bkout-one-workflow-backend|workflow-queue-workers"}) * on(namespace) group_left(refold_version) label_replace(max by (namespace,image_spec)(kube_pod_container_info{container="cobalt-frontend"}),"refold_version","$1","image_spec",".*:v?(.*)")) or ((kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace="<NAMESPACE>",deployment=~"bkout-one-workflow-backend|workflow-queue-workers"} < on(namespace,deployment) kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace="<NAMESPACE>",deployment=~"bkout-one-workflow-backend|workflow-queue-workers"}) unless on(namespace) label_replace(max by (namespace,image_spec)(kube_pod_container_info{container="cobalt-frontend"}),"refold_version","$1","image_spec",".*:v?(.*)"))

annotations.description: {{ $labels.deployment }} has fewer Ready replicas than desired for >5m — pods are crashing/being recreated or can't schedule. (Per-pod alerts miss this because pods churn faster than their for:15m window.)
annotations.resolution: 1) kubectl -n {{ $labels.namespace }} get deploy {{ $labels.deployment }} ; kubectl -n {{ $labels.namespace }} get pods -l app={{ $labels.deployment }} -o wide  2) check pod events/logs (liveness /api/v1/workflow/health, OOM, scheduling)  3) if 'Insufficient cpu/memory' -> cluster capacity (scale nodes / apply gcsfuse safe-to-evict)  4) if liveness timeouts -> check app health/DB(Atlas) connectivity.
